name: Lowball 💰
desc:
💰LOWBALL 

Buy low, sell high! Run your own pawn shop, make risky deals, and build a flipping empire!

🎁 Use code 1MVISITS for a free boost!
👍 New code at 6K LIKES

How to Play:
🤝 Lowball customers to buy their items cheap
🎲 Bluff and make offers before they walk away
💰 Put your items on display and sell to buyers for profit
🏪 Upgrade your shop, hire employees, and unlock more


👥 Join the group for bonuses and updates
✅ Supports PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console
